text:
sarah.support: Customer reported a surge of cross-region latency + wrong-region billing. They claim they set region=eu via our SDK but requests landed in us-west. Can we triage? :thinking_face:

maya-cs: Customer says this started after they flipped a cloud load-balancer that injects a header for internal tracing.

ingress-bot: New request sample captured (from the customer's proxy):
```
GET /v1/generate?model=redwood-mini&region=eu HTTP/1.1
Host: api.redwood.ai
User-Agent: sample-client/1.2.0
X-Forwarded-For: 10.0.0.45
X-Added-Region: eu
```

sarah.support: Note the LB set X-Added-Region instead of the canonical X-Client-Region header we document. The customer thought query param region=eu would be authoritative.

alex-platform: Quick checks: our router precedence is (1) explicit header X-Client-Region, (2) query param region, (3) account default. If LB injects a different header name (X-Added-Region) it won't be picked up. But above request has region=eu in query string — why did it get routed to us-west?

jordan-runtime-oncall: Looking at router logs for that request id (rid: r-0a1b2c):
```
2026-03-04T14:12:09Z router INFO rid=r-0a1b2c parse: query.region = "eu"
2026-03-04T14:12:09Z router DEBUG rid=r-0a1b2c header.X-Client-Region = ""
2026-03-04T14:12:09Z router WARN rid=r-0a1b2c region_lookup: query.region invalid format: "eu"
2026-03-04T14:12:09Z router INFO rid=r-0a1b2c chosen_region = "us-west-2" (nearest)
```

jordan-runtime-oncall: Important bit: the router's region parser expects full region tokens (e.g., eu-west-1 or eu-central-1). It treats short names ("eu") as malformed and falls back. So even though query param existed, value rejected.

maya-cs: Customer insists they were using older SDK that sends short region tokens. They upgraded load-balancer which also added X-Added-Region.

alex-platform: That explains misroute. Two failure modes combined: LB header uses non-standard key, and query param value format doesn't match our canonical region set. We should return a clearer error when query.region is syntactically invalid instead of silently falling back.

sarah.support: Customer is asking for immediate mitigation — can we 1) route their traffic to eu immediately, 2) avoid extra egress charges?

jordan-runtime-oncall: Short-term: we can add a per-account router override to honor query.region if it exactly equals one of our canonical regions. For this customer I can flip a flag to force region=eu-central-1 mapping for their org id. Requires an infra change but low-risk.

alex-platform: Longer term: two items — (A) accept short region aliases from SDKs (map "eu" -> eu-central-1) and (B) log/return a 4xx when region param is present but unparseable. Also update docs to call out header name precedence and LB pitfalls.

ingress-bot: Repro steps added to ticket 12345:
1) curl through customer's LB that injects header:
```
curl -i -H "X-Added-Region: eu" "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate?model=redwood-mini&region=eu" -H "Authorization: Bearer x"
```
2) Observe router decision in logs: fallback to nearest when region token not canonical.
3) Repeat with canonical region token: region=eu-central-1 -> routes to EU edge.
```

maya-cs: Customer asks for a temp mitigation they can apply on their side — suggested fixes: ensure LB sets X-Client-Region OR append canonical region in query param. They prefer server-side change though.

jordan-runtime-oncall: I pushed an org-level override for their org id that maps short alias "eu" -> eu-central-1. Confirmed new requests are landing in EU.

alex-platform: I'll open a PR to add alias mapping and to make the router emit a 400 with a hint when query.region exists but is malformed.

sarah.support: Customer confirmed latency normalized and billing route corrected. They're happy with the temporary fix but asked for a postmortem with clear docs on LB header name.

jordan-runtime-oncall: Postmortem checklist items: update region parser, add alias map, add better logging + 4xx, doc update about header names (X-Client-Region required), communicate to SDK teams about region token formats.

alex-platform: tagging eng-runtime and devex for SDK guidance. @jordan-runtime-oncall please include the minimal infra change we made in the ticket. :thumbsup:

sarah.support: closing loop with customer now. Thanks team.

ingress-bot: action created: TICKET-12345 -> org override set, follow-up PR open (runtime#452).
